title: Transcutaneous Electrical Acupoint Stimulation Improves Postoperative Sleep Quality in Patients Undergoing Laparoscopic Gastrointestinal Tumor Surgery: A Prospective, Randomized Controlled Trial
source_read: Complete 16-page publication; visually inspected PDF pp6,8,9.
population: Adults 18–75, laparoscopic gastric/colorectal tumor resection under general anesthesia; Dec2021–Aug2022, two Chinese hospitals.
source_conflicts: Abstract allocation n83 is completer count; Fig2 randomized88.
No administered rescue drug, route, dose or threshold specified.

results.eligibility: Graph digitization or author values required; no point estimates read from graph

opioid_candidate.reason: Administration counts over72h; no postoperative opioid mass or exact24 exposure.

independence: Registry reused in Ge et al.2025 cohort report and autonomic-function cohort; overlap unresolved; do not independently count linked cohort reports.

rob2.outcome: Pain rest/activity; PONV; first flatus; abdominal distension

signaling_questions.evidence: Computer-generated random-number table.

signaling_questions.question: 1.2 Was the allocation sequence concealed until participants were enrolled and assigned?
signaling_questions.evidence: Sequentially numbered opaque sealed envelopes.
signaling_questions.reasoning: Opening safeguards incompletely described, but probably concealed.

signaling_questions.question: 1.3 Did baseline differences suggest a problem with randomization?
signaling_questions.evidence: Table 1 describes completers only.
signaling_questions.reasoning: Randomized baseline set unavailable; no compelling imbalance among completers.

domains.reasoning: Random sequence and probably concealed allocation.
Unexplained protocol-breach exclusions and unclear trial-context deviations.
5/88 excluded without outcome-specific reasons or sensitivity analysis.
Sensory masking uncertain for patient-reported outcomes; likely influence not demonstrated.
Prospective result-specific analysis plan not demonstrated.

rob2.overall_reasoning: Several uncertainties, but no evidence sufficient to establish a high-risk domain; domains must be reconsidered for each result in Phase B.
